resources.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code with PBE functional and PAW/NC pseudopotentials (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, GPAW)
PAW or norm-conserving pseudopotentials for In, Ga, Zn, O (treating In 4d, Ga 3d, Zn 3d as valence)
Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE) or Pymatgen for structure manipulation
resources.notes: Optional convenience library; can be replaced by manual scripting.
